items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: My cousin, Marcus Callender, who was also a warrant officer in the Army... He conducted a band.

ctx.x: You mentioned at the beginning of the oral history an annual reunion of Callenders.

Yes. That's in Lunenberg, Massachusetts. My cousin, Marcus Callender, who was also a warrant officer in the Army... He conducted a band. He started in Washington, and he conducted an Army band in Germany and all over. He was a very good musician. He has since retired from the Army, and he is going... He just sent me a letter the other day. He's got some sort of a degree in Security, whatever that means. It probably means that he's in charge of security for a bank or something in that town. But he had to go to…
He's the one that organizes the Callender reunion?
